name: LND
description: LND is a Lightning Network daemon for Bitcoin. This script installs LND in a Debian 13 LXC with optional RTL web UI and optional Tor support.

notes.text: Create /opt/lnd/lnd.conf after installation to match your Bitcoin node before using LND.
Wallet creation remains manual by design. Run `lncli create` after configuration is complete.
RTL is optional and becomes usable after the LND wallet and macaroon files exist.
If RTL is installed, configure it yourself or use the optional helper referenced in /opt/lnd/README.md; the RTL password is stored in /opt/rtl/RTL-Config.json as multiPass.
